prerequisite_failures.cause: Fixed-time login recipe advanced before login art completed; navigation was recorded during new-file scan. Separate retry increases login page waits and declines scan explicitly.

scope: Four actual DOS sessions on the combined mouse/sound build: record read-only BBS navigation, compile the original and a separate DOS-child wrapper with DOS ASPCOMP, replay the wrapper, navigate manually afterward, then exact UART/DOS restoration. The wrapper first runs a missing target and a successful child; conditional BAD wire output is absent. Sound PRM word is enabled; audible output and mouse movement are not observed by this BBS harness. Loopback Hayes model; no physical modem, transfers or full application acceptance.
